statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON / green. Overnight equity futures are near flat after Monday’s technology-led record close, and fresh granular NQ pullback depth is not independently verified; Tail therefore remains low.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains below WATCH because current evidence does not establish persistent no-retracement structure; the next concentrated conditional risk window is the U.S. cash open and Fed-speaker sequence.
headline: Overnight futures pause after Monday’s technology surge, leaving Tail low ahead of Tuesday’s event cluster
body: Monday’s record Nasdaq close and broad semiconductor strength remain important context, while fresh shared Finviz breadth still confirms broad technology participation. Overnight equity futures are near flat and oil has only modestly rebounded. Without verified granular NQ continuation or repeated failed retracements, Stress remains extreme but Tail stays low.

lookbackSummary: Across the preceding 24 UTC clock-hours, Tail moved from low overnight into elevated/high during Monday’s U.S. session, peaked at 38% in power hour, fell sharply during the maintenance interval, returned to WATCH after the reopen, and eased to 19% by 00:00 UTC.
outlookSummary: Current Tail is 18% / low because Monday’s strong trend has not been verified as persisting in fresh overnight NQ structure. Overnight Tail stays low-to-WATCH absent failed retracements or near-extreme holding. The principal conditional danger window is 13:30–15:30 UTC around the cash open and Williams/Jefferson sequence; Barkin and power hour are later checkpoints.

forecast.analysis: U.S. equity futures are near flat after Monday’s technology-led record close; delayed contextual NQ indications are only marginally positive. Fresh granular pullback depth is not independently verified, so the current hour does not show a confirmed persistent no-retracement path.
drivers: Overnight equity futures are near flat rather than extending Monday’s cash-session surge
Fresh granular NQ pullback depth is not independently verified
Fresh shared Finviz context confirms broad prior-session tech strength but is not live path evidence

forecast.analysis: Tail stays low if the overnight session remains two-way and does not develop repeated extension after failed pullbacks. Monday’s strong technology breadth remains context, while thin liquidity can amplify moves without proving durable mean-reversion failure.
drivers: Overnight two-way rotation is the base condition
Repeated extension after failed pullbacks would be the escalation trigger
Prior-session technology breadth remains contextual

forecast.analysis: A normal overnight regime remains the base case unless price begins holding near session extremes with shallow retracements. Oil and geopolitical headlines can lift Stress quickly, but higher Tail requires directional NQ confirmation.
drivers: Near-extreme holding is a conditional Tail trigger
Oil and geopolitical headlines primarily raise Stress without NQ confirmation

forecast.analysis: Low Tail persists if overnight price discovery continues to rotate rather than trend efficiently. A fresh directional break that repeatedly rejects meaningful retracement would invalidate this low-risk path.
drivers: Two-way overnight price discovery
Repeated rejection of meaningful retracement would invalidate the low-Tail path

forecast.analysis: The quieter pre-Europe window remains low Tail under balanced trade. A large gap or one-way move can raise Stress, but Tail should stay below WATCH unless pullbacks remain shallow or fail repeatedly.
drivers: Pre-Europe liquidity remains a lower-Tail window
Gap size alone does not establish pathological price-path risk

forecast.analysis: Into the Europe pre-open, Tail remains low unless a directional move survives meaningful retracement attempts. Monday’s U.S. technology strength can shape sentiment but does not substitute for fresh NQ structure.
drivers: Europe pre-open transition
Meaningful retracement attempts are the key structure checkpoint
Monday’s technology rally remains prior-session context

forecast.analysis: At the European cash open, two-way price discovery keeps Tail low. A sustained break with repeated failed retracements would move risk toward WATCH, especially if rates, oil and technology leadership align.
drivers: European cash-open price discovery
Failed-retracement sequence would raise Tail
Cross-asset alignment matters only with persistent NQ structure

forecast.analysis: Tail remains low if the first European hour rotates around its opening range. Persistent one-way expansion with shallow pullbacks would be the evidence needed for escalation.
drivers: European opening-range behavior
Shallow pullbacks plus persistent expansion would be an escalation signal

forecast.analysis: WATCH becomes appropriate only if European trade carries a directional move into the U.S. premarket without meaningful retracement. Otherwise the regime should remain mixed despite elevated event-day Stress.
drivers: U.S. premarket transition begins to matter
Carry-through from Europe requires retracement failure for higher Tail
Event-day Stress rises before the U.S. session

forecast.analysis: The U.S. premarket remains a WATCH-level checkpoint if directional efficiency persists. Without failed pullbacks or near-extreme holding, generic premarket volatility should affect Stress more than Tail.
drivers: Premarket directional-efficiency checkpoint
Generic volatility raises Stress more readily than Tail

forecast.analysis: Tail stays in WATCH territory as U.S. liquidity builds, but a block requires observed persistence rather than anticipation. Broad technology strength from Monday is supportive context, not proof of a new one-way session.
drivers: U.S. liquidity is building ahead of the cash open
A block requires observed persistence, not anticipation
Monday’s broad technology strength remains contextual

drivers: Cash-open proximity raises Stress
Pre-open gap persistence is a conditional Tail trigger

forecast.analysis: The 13:30 UTC U.S. cash open is the first concentrated danger checkpoint. Elevated Tail is conditional on an opening-auction move that holds near extremes, extends after failed pullbacks, or shows similarly persistent directional efficiency.
drivers: 13:30 UTC U.S. cash open
Opening-auction continuation is a conditional Tail trigger
Near-extreme holding and failed pullbacks would confirm persistence

forecast.analysis: This hour contains the Richmond Fed survey window and the Williams/Jefferson remarks. Tail reaches elevated only if the cash-open path is already persistent and the speaker sequence reinforces one-way extension; the events themselves primarily raise Stress.

John Williams remarks at 14:05 UTC
Philip Jefferson remarks at 14:20 UTC

drivers: Post-speaker price-discovery checkpoint
Two-way rotation would de-escalate Tail
Shallow or failed retracements would keep Tail elevated

forecast.analysis: After the main speaker cluster, WATCH is the base state if price becomes more two-way. A renewed push to session extremes with failed retracements would invalidate that de-escalation.
drivers: Post-event normalization checkpoint

forecast.analysis: Tom Barkin’s scheduled remarks create another event checkpoint. Elevated Tail is conditional on an already persistent directional path that the remarks extend; absent that structure, the event should mostly keep Stress elevated.
drivers: Tom Barkin remarks at 17:00 UTC
Speaker-driven continuation needs existing directional persistence
Without persistent structure, the event mainly affects Stress

forecast.analysis: After the Barkin checkpoint, Tail falls back to WATCH if the market absorbs the event with two-way rotation. Repeated extension after failed retracements would keep risk elevated.
drivers: Post-Barkin absorption
Two-way rotation supports Tail de-escalation
Repeated extension would keep risk elevated

forecast.analysis: Power-hour risk rises conditionally if the session is already trending and price remains near extremes. A balanced afternoon with meaningful retracements would keep Tail closer to WATCH despite late-session liquidity.
drivers: Late-session setup ahead of power hour
Near-extreme holding would raise Tail
Meaningful retracements would cap Tail

forecast.analysis: The 19:00 UTC power hour is a conditional continuation checkpoint. Elevated Tail requires renewed one-way extension, shallow pullbacks or repeated failed retracements; otherwise late-session volatility should not be treated as a block by itself.
drivers: 19:00 UTC power hour
Renewed one-way extension would sustain elevated Tail
Late-session volatility alone does not establish mean-reversion failure

forecast.analysis: After the U.S. cash close, Tail should ease toward WATCH if the closing move does not continue into futures. A persistent post-close extension would be the main reason to resist de-escalation.
drivers: U.S. cash market has closed
Post-close continuation is the key conditional checkpoint

forecast.analysis: The CME daily maintenance interval removes continuous futures price discovery. Tail returns to low in the absence of new executable path evidence, while headline risk can still keep Stress elevated.
drivers: CME daily maintenance limits continuous futures price discovery
Headline risk can remain high without live path evidence

forecast.analysis: At the Globex reopen, WATCH is appropriate only if price immediately re-establishes near-extreme holding or repeated extension. A stable reopen with meaningful two-way trade would keep Tail below the blocking threshold.
drivers: Globex reopen price-discovery checkpoint
Immediate near-extreme holding would raise Tail
Stable two-way trade would keep Tail below 25%

forecast.analysis: Late overnight Tail returns to low if the reopen does not produce persistent directional efficiency. The next session’s event risk remains ahead, but future catalysts are not treated as observed path evidence.
drivers: Late overnight persistence check
Future catalysts are not counted as observed structure
